subject: Air freight quote request – Munich to BKK
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to BKK (Bangkok, TH)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-23 at our site in 80186 (Munich), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 7 pieces of electronic control units, with a gross weight of 923 kg and a total volume of 7.96 cbm.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR, including pickup, and let me know the earliest available arrival at BKK.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm
